dialogues.speaker: Merry-Witch
dialogues.text: As of late, the tricksy-witch has nearly the entirety of the snowy lands in her grasp. Now, none but the Tsar can command her submission.

dialogues.speaker: Merry-Witch
dialogues.text: Such a pity that she can no longer spare the time to join our gatherings...

dialogues.speaker: Sage-Witch
dialogues.text: Tell me, does the wander-witch still roam among the stars?

dialogues.speaker: Merry-Witch
dialogues.text: Who can say how long we'll have to wait for her return? I had hoped sharing all the fun little stories from our gatherings might entice her to remain.

dialogues.speaker: Seer-Witch
dialogues.text: Then how about the memory-witch? Does she still walk the mortal realm?

dialogues.speaker: Merry-Witch
dialogues.text: Yes... She has that secret mission of hers to accomplish, so she couldn't make it to our gathering. But, she doesn't seem to regret her choice, so naturally, it's not my place to pry.

dialogues.speaker: Story-Witch
dialogues.text: As rare a chance to gather as this, and yet almost half of us are absent...

dialogues.speaker: Merry-Witch
dialogues.text: Cheer up! At least you came with good tidings.

dialogues.speaker: Story-Witch
dialogues.text: I suppose I'm just feeling a little... sentimental. After all, there will come a day when I, too, am among those absent at these gatherings.
